guide: GPUI Kit design-guides.md @ 944803984cf0 (design review, accessibility, interaction states, feedback and overlays, data-heavy, interface language)
data: Live retained data: 1 planning record (team "test"), 0 issues/requests/views/inbox items; dialogs opened then dismissed, no non-GET sent
recorded_deviations: Header creation command stays `primary` (kiln.web.visual_design requires one primary action per view) although the guide would use a default Button for a command that only opens a form; label ends with an ellipsis.
Navigation to console routes stays a link (row titles, relationships, planning categories, saved views/favorites, roadmap rows, Use this view, All attention preferences); commands stay buttons.
44px touch targets at <=60rem; no OS menus or window chrome.

findings: Open record shown with a 3px leading-edge bar (guide: selection on the item's own surface, no one-sided bar)
Row title was a Button that only navigates (web deviation: route navigation must be a link)
Overdue due date distinguished by colour alone
Commands opening forms lacked an ellipsis (New issue, Save current view, Edit metadata, Add sub-issue, Set reminder)
Signed-write confirmation used window.confirm: generic OK/Cancel, no object+verb, browser chrome
Record commands (Edit, Watch...) sat below facts, links and evidence; Hide list sat alone on its own band above the heading
Priority 'No priority' badge in the detail eyebrow spent emphasis on an unset value
fixes: aria-current row: list-active fill + full inset hairline; multi-selected row: fill + checked box
Row titles and relationship targets are real links (href keeps open-in-new-tab/history; plain click uses in-app navigate)
Overdue rows read 'Overdue · due <time>'
Ellipsis added to every form-opening command; label 'Edit metadata' -> 'Edit…'

In-page alert dialog: title names verb+object (e.g. Create issue “X”?), commit names the result, 'Keep editing'/'Cancel' dismissal, body keeps principal, object, expected head, each changed field and the non-authority statement; focus returns to the opener
Commands moved directly under title/description; Hide list joins the close control in the heading's trailing lane
Priority shown only when set

findings: 'Browse my private preferences' was a Button that navigates
'Attention preferences' opens a form without ellipsis
Attention-reason badges used the info colour as decoration
fixes: Navigation link 'All attention preferences'
'Attention preferences…'
Attention reasons are neutral badges

findings: Category tabs were Buttons navigating routes with an underline bar as the selection marker; wrapped into three rows at 320px
Rows and detail drew an empty 0/0 progress meter for records with no linked scope
Roadmap card shown even when there are no planning records
fixes: Categories are links in one segmented silhouette; selected item is a raised fill; strip scrolls horizontally when narrow with inset focus rings
No meter without linked records; detail says 'No linked records yet.'
Roadmap omitted when the current scope has no planning records; roadmap titles are links

findings: Dialog commits read 'Persist snooze'/'Persist duplicate'
'Route / edit request' duplicated Edit
Accept/Decline confirmed through window.confirm
fixes: Commits 'Snooze' / 'Mark duplicate', titles 'Snooze “X”' / 'Mark “X” as duplicate'
Removed the duplicate; help text points to Edit…
Confirmations 'Accept “X” to backlog?' / 'Decline request “X”?'

findings: Saved-view and favorite pills were Buttons navigating routes
'Use this view' Button navigates
'Create private/shared copy' opens a form without ellipsis
fixes: Pills are links with aria-current on the item surface
'Use this view' is a button-styled link
Ellipsis added

findings: Reaction chips had no pressed state for 'mine'
Comment/reaction dialog commits read 'Persist reaction'
Toggle labels did not predict their result in all surfaces
fixes: aria-pressed on reaction chips
'Save reaction', 'Edit comment…', 'React…'
Watch/Unwatch, Favorite/Remove favorite, Mark read/Mark unread pass the explicit target state

findings: Edit dialog title did not name the record
Raw rgb backdrop in work.css and work-interaction.css
Reminder commit 'Persist private reminder'
fixes: 'Edit <kind> “X”'
Overrides removed; shared dialog::backdrop (var(--overlay)) applies
'Set reminder'; title 'Set reminder for “X”'

findings: A details group of buttons without menu semantics or arrow keys; trigger not visibly pressed while open; stayed open when focus left
fixes: role=menu/menuitem with roving focus (arrows, Home/End), Escape returns to the trigger, focus-out/Tab closes, aria-expanded synced, open trigger keeps its pressed fill; shared .menu-item rows

findings: Implemented as a centred modal dialog titled 'Work actions' with a help paragraph (guide: menu, not dialog)
'Toggle watch…/Toggle favorite…/Mark current head read…' did not predict the result; ellipsis on commands that need no further input
Trigger announced aria-haspopup=dialog
fixes: Anchored popover menu (role=menu, arrows/Home/End, Escape/outside click dismiss, focus back to the trigger, flips/clamps inside the viewport; context-menu opens at the pointer)
Items show row shortcuts (Enter, Space, X) and use the detail's verbs with explicit target state
aria-haspopup=menu, aria-expanded while open, pressed trigger fill

findings: Active option marked with a leading-edge bar
Create entries open forms without ellipsis
Pointer cursor on options and summary; non-token .6875rem sizes
fixes: Active option: list-active fill + full hairline; hover fill only
'New issue…' etc.
Default cursor; text-xs token

findings: 'Set status…/Set priority…/Set assignee…' carried an ellipsis though they only confirm
fixes: 'Set status' / 'Set priority' / 'Set assignee'; confirmations name verb and target, multi-record note retained
